verdict.rationale: Fivetran is documented only as a managed SaaS platform with 'SaaS Deployment' and 'Hybrid Deployment' models (fivetran-docs-8, fivetran-docs-26, fivetran-docs-68); Hybrid Deployment merely runs a local agent that still connects to Fivetran's cloud control plane, not a self-hosted core product. Community commentary even contrasts Fivetran unfavorably with Airbyte specifically because Airbyte is open-source and self-hostable while Fivetran is not (fivetran-comm-5). No evidence anywhere of an on-prem/self-hosted core offering.
